tasks.description: The search box should be prominently displayed and easily accessible from all pages. It should have a clear input field for users to type their queries and a submit button to initiate the search. The design should be modern and consistent with the rest of the app.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is on the homepage, when they click on the search box, then the input field is focused and ready for typing.
Given a user types a query in the search box, when they press the submit button, then the search results page is displayed.

tasks.description: This task involves creating a backend endpoint that handles search queries. It should parse the query, interact with the database to find relevant results, and return these results in a format that can be easily consumed by the frontend.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search query, when the backend receives the query, then it returns a list of relevant results.
Given a search query with no results, when the backend receives the query, then it returns an empty list.

tasks.description: This task involves displaying the search results in a user-friendly manner. Each result should have a clear title, a brief description, and a link to the relevant page. The results should be ordered by relevance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of search results, when they are displayed, then each result has a title, description, and link.
Given a list of search results, when they are displayed, then they are ordered by relevance.

tasks.description: To improve search performance, we need to index the data that will be searched. This involves creating and maintaining an index of the relevant data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new piece of data, when it is added to the system, then it is indexed for search.
Given a search query, when the search is performed, then the results are returned quickly.

tasks.description: To ensure the search feature works correctly, we need to write comprehensive tests. These tests should cover different scenarios, including searching for existing and non-existing data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search query, when the search is performed, then the results are correct.
Given a search query with no results, when the search is performed, then an empty list is returned.
